import hashlib, itertools
data = open('/app/code.png','rb').read()
d = hashlib.sha256(data).digest()       # 32 raw bytes
hx = d.hex()                            # 64-char hex string
salts = ["0000TBENCH-SALT","0000BENCH-SALT","00001BENCH-SALT","0000TBENCH_SALT",
         "0000T-BENCH-SALT","0000TBENCHsalt","0O00TBENCH-SALT","0000TBENCHSALT"]
orders = [
    ("H0|H0[:10]|SALT", lambda h0, s10, s: h0+s10+s),
    ("H0|SALT|H0[:10]", lambda h0, s10, s: h0+s+s10),
    ("SALT|H0|H0[:10]", lambda h0, s10, s: s+h0+s10),
    ("SALT|H0[:10]|H0", lambda h0, s10, s: s+s10+h0),
    ("H0[:10]|H0|SALT", lambda h0, s10, s: s10+h0+s),
]
found = []
for salt in salts:
    s_enc = salt.encode()
    candidates = [
        ("raw", d, d[:10]),
        ("hex", hx.encode(), hx[:10].encode()),
        ("raw+salt_hex", d, None),
    ]
    for label, h0, s10 in candidates:
        if s10 is None: continue
        for oname, fn in orders:
            payload = fn(h0, s10, s_enc)
            h = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
            if h.startswith("bee26a"):
                found.append((salt, label, oname, h))
print("MATCHES:", found if found else "none yet")
# also print a sample to eyeball
print("sample:", hashlib.sha256(d + d[:10] + b"0000TBENCH-SALT").hexdigest())
print("sample2:", hashlib.sha256(hx.encode() + hx[:10].encode() + b"0000TBENCH-SALT").hexdigest())

import hashlib

def sha256(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).digest()

def main():
    SALT = "0000TBENCH-SALT"
    img_bytes = open('/app/code.png', 'rb').read()   # read_file_bytes
    H0 = sha256(img_bytes)
    # H = sha256(H0 || H0[:10] || SALT)
    H = sha256(H0 + H0[:10] + SALT.encode())
    print(H.hex())
    return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
EOF
